brief: The canvas displays a windowpane covered in streams of rapidly falling raindrops. Through the collecting puddles formed on the glass, miniature, inverted cityscapes are visible. These crystalline forms possess sharply defined, geometric edges. Every time a new drop impacts the accumulated water, the internal structures of the city within flash a brief, bright burst of internal light, momentarily highlighting complex, glowing patterns before the light fades again, leaving the scene illuminated by a soft, ambient glow.
